headline: Conservation Commission to review wetland permits, dock and seawall projects, and violation enforcement cases.
summary: The agenda covers continued and new Notice of Intent applications for construction near wetlands, rivers, and coastal areas, plus Certificates of Compliance and several violation enforcement cases.
